title: Collision time
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the collision time as 2 seconds.

title: Minimum safe distance
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the minimum safe distance as 2 meters.

title: Initial velocities identified
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly extract the initial velocities from the graph and equation (4 m/s for motorcycle, 3 m/s for car).

title: Accelerations determined
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the decelerations from the slope and equation (0.5 m/s² for motorcycle, 0.25 m/s² for car).

title: Correct kinematic equations
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up the correct displacement equations for both vehicles under uniform deceleration.

title: Relative displacement condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the condition that the motorcycle's extra displacement equals the initial gap L for collision.

title: Physical root selection
description: Important Criteria: The student must discard the non-physical solution (e.g., t=6s) from the quadratic equation for collision time.

title: Velocity equality analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The student may find the time (4s) when the vehicles' speeds become equal as part of the safe distance reasoning.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly uses positive acceleration values in the kinematic equations instead of negative for deceleration.

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student provides final answers without proper units (s, m) or uses inconsistent units in calculations.
